Unfold `Finsupp.prod`: it is the finite product
\[
\prod_{a\in f.\mathrm{support}} g(a)(f(a)).
\]
For the first conjunct, apply the standard prime-divides-a-finite-product characterization for the prime \(p\). This converts divisibility of the whole product exactly into the existence of an index \(a\in f.\mathrm{support}\) such that \(p\mid g(a)(f(a))\). If a suitable library lemma is inconvenient, prove this intermediate statement by induction on `f.support`, using Euclid’s lemma \(p\mid xy \leftrightarrow p\mid x\lor p\mid y\).

The second conjunct, `Nat.minFac 1 = 1`, follows directly by computation/simplification from the definition of `Nat.minFac`. Combine the two independently established conjuncts.
